item.description: Republican Governor Phil Scott won a historic sixth term as Vermont governor with Molly Gray winning as lieutenant governor. Democrats flipped multiple legislative seats across the state. U.S. Representative Becca Balint was also reelected easily.

Jeff Haylon won the Rutland-nine House District race .Alicia Malay won a second term in the Rutland-eight House District. David Bosch and Thomas Burditt are likely winners in the Rutland-two House race. Jonathan Hescock leads Jim Casey in the Addison-Rutland House race. Phoebe Tucker won the Rutland-Windsor House District seat.

Vermonters approved two constitutional amendments Tuesday. One protects collective bargaining rights and bans right-to-work laws. The other guarantees equal protection under the law regardless of race, gender, and other factors.

David Wolk won a Rutland County Senate seat as an independent. He previously served in the Vermont Senate and retired as Castleton University president. Republican Brian Collamore was re-elected, while Senator Terry Williams appears to have lost.
